q1_issues.issue: (Member devil_rays team) types a proper noun from world knowledge — no kind word sits inside or beside "Devil Rays" in the text, so no words put this atom there.

(Experiencer sk_doubt_1 sk_future_1) makes the future the experiencer of a doubting eventuality, but "is in doubt" names no doubter and predicates uncertainty of the future, not a psych state held by it.
(Member sk_problems_1 unspecified) predicates a descriptive modifier of the group symbol itself, which the plural rules explicitly warn against — it should distribute over the members.

q2_gaps: a predicative PP as copular complement ("X is in doubt", "at risk", "under review") — the instruction set covers adjectival predicates and locative/domain PPs but not idiomatic predicate PPs, and the "in" mapping otherwise forces LocatedIn
a content noun taking a clausal complement ("an announcement he will miss the season") — sealing under Theme is defined for attitude VERBS only, never for an event-denoting noun
notes: BecauseOf reads as an event-side oblique named after its own (multi-word) preposition, so it is treated as licensed rather than as a coined causal head. The announcement is correctly given its Time term and the Before ordering with no tense of its own, per the temporal-anchor rule.
